title: Ticker (one venue's top-of-book quote)
description: One venue's quote for one instrument at one instant. Called Ticker in Go (apps/executor/internal/execution/records.go Ticker) and VenueQuote in TS (apps/web/src/features/market/ticker/client.ts) - two names, one concept (canonical-model.md D2; Quote is the canonical name, Ticker is the legacy synonym kept in code). ABSENCE IS HONEST by explicit rule: an unreported level is null/empty, never a fabricated zero and never a borrowed trade price (apps/executor/internal/execution/records.go Ticker doc: 'a last-only ticker must never be turned into a fabricated touch price'; the TS VenueQuote doc says the same: 'a null is a real this venue did not report it, never coerced to 0'). No best-bid/ask means the fields are null, not equal to last.

observed_at.description: The Go field is `Ts` (a time.Time); the TS field is `at` (venue milliseconds, 'so a stale quote is visible as stale').
